Moletai Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Utenos apskritis, Lithuania

Demolished. Known in Yiddish as Maliat, this town's Jewish community reached 81 percent of the population by 1897 and sustained an active civic life — Yiddish and Hebrew schools, Zionist youth movements, a Bund chapter — until German forces herded the entire community into the Beit Midrash for three days without food or water in August 1941, then marched them a mile out of town and shot them into a mass grave. This, the older of Moletai's two Jewish cemeteries, was itself destroyed in 1958 when a street was built through it; construction of apartment buildings around 1970 unearthed human bones, and no memorial marks the site today. The town's second Jewish cemetery, near the local stadium, survives.
